name: Fourmungousaur
abilities: Combined strength of Four Arms and Humungousaur
Shock waves from clapping/pounding with four arms
Size alteration (Vaxasaurian growth, per crew statements)
weaknesses: No weaknesses documented on the wiki; presumably shares its components' bulk and lack of ranged attacks
summary: Ben 10,000's Biomnitrix fusion of Four Arms and Humungousaur: a red-and-tan armoured dinosaur with four Tetramand arms and the pooled strength of both, used to bulldoze evil Bens.
traits: Only combination alien never to speak
Four Humungousaur arms wearing Four Arms' gloves
notableFeats: Overpowered Mad Ben's Rath and broke free of Benzarro's Snare-Oh bandages (And Then There Were None)
Defeated Eon (And Then There Was Ben)

appearances.designNotes: Humungousaur's body with Four Arms' features: two-toned skin with Four Arms' red replacing the darker tan; four Humungousaur arms wearing Four Arms' gloves; Four Arms' spikes on arms and head; Humungousaur's white belt with green stripe under Four Arms' pants; Four Arms' feet with Humungousaur toenails; Four Arms-shaped head with Humungousaur's nose; Biomnitrix symbol on the sash.

image.label: OV
image.notes: Infobox render; the wiki file '94731.png' redirects to 'Fourmungousaur.png' (same image, 1168x924) - either name resolves via imageinfo.

scoring.rationale: Pooled Tetramand + Vaxasaurian muscle: overpowered an Appoplexian, tore free of Thep Khufan bandages and beat Eon, with growth on tap and shock-wave claps. Pure bruiser - no range, average speed, and only two brief outings.

notes: Used only by the Omniverse Ben 10,000 via the Biomnitrix (And Then There Were None: non-speaking; And Then There Was Ben: cameo).
Size alteration is confirmed by Derrick J. Wyatt / Charlotte McDuffie statements rather than shown on-screen.

Biomnitrix context: the Omniverse Ben 10,000 (Original Future timeline, re-established as Ben Prime's true future) wears two linked Omnitrix gauntlets; slamming them together fuses two aliens on the fly (combinations are generated at transformation time, not stored). Each gauntlet alone gives normal aliens; it is voice-controlled and can be knocked out by a large EMP or Chronosapien time-freeze. All on-screen fusions were drawn by Thomas N. Perkins IV; the device name was coined by Derrick J. Wyatt (unnamed in scripts).
